name: reverse-lunge-with-twist
instructions:
1. In an upright position, step back into a reverse lunge until the back knee touches the floor.
2. Once in position, dynamically rotate the shoulders over the front leg.
3. Rotate your torso back to the neutral position and then step back to your starting position.
4. Alternate legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
